units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 8:7">Tosef. Snh. VIII, 7</cite> <he>אדם</he> … <he>ש׳ היה עמו וכ׳</he> Adam was the last created, in order that the heretics might not say, he was God’s associate in his work; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:13">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 3:5:2">Y. B. Bath. III, 14ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ש׳ … כנוטע ברשות</he> if a partner goes in and plants (a portion of the ground), he is considered as one who plants with the owner’s assent, i.e. he cannot claim the cultivated portion as his exclusive property on the ground of undisturbed possession; Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 42b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ אין לו חזקה</he> (not <cite ref="U00587"><he>שותפות</he></cite>) a partner cannot claim possession (v. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:47">Y. Snh. I, 19ᵇ</cite> top <he>ש׳ ליסטים כליסטים</he> a robber’s partner is considered a robber; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁוּתָּפִים</he>, <he>שׁוּתָּפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 1:1">Ib. I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
Kidd. 30ᵇ שלשה ש׳ הן באדם וכ׳ three partners have a share in man: the Lord, his father, and his mother; if a man honors his parents &c.; Nidd. 31ᵃ; a. e.—Fem. שׁוּתֶּפֶת.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>שהיתה ש׳ בשני וכ׳</he> she (Tadmor) took part in the two destructions of the Temple; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:23">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite>.
